# `assets/humanoid/SkeletonHeal.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/humanoid/SkeletonHeal.js`

engine/assets/humanoid/SkeletonHeal.js — anatomy-aware, NON-DESTRUCTIVE skeleton repair. When a rig is missing or mislabels core bones, infer them from anatomy (the same heuristics auto-riggers use): • Pelvis = the point between the two hip joints (and the retarget root must be the pelvis, NOT a ground/root-motion bone — so a "Root"/Armature bone at the floor is replaced by the leg-derived pelvis). • Missing spine / chest / neck are interpolated along the hips→head chain. • A missing left/right limb is MIRRORED from the present side across the body's sagittal plane (auto-mirror). Inferred joints are written to `rig.synthesized` (slot → position) — the source model is never modified. `humanoidBonePosition()` returns the real joint if it exists, else the synthesized one.

## Functions

### `humanoidBonePosition(rig, slot, pose)`

Real or synthesized world position for a canonical slot (or null).

### `healHumanoid(model, rig, pose)`

Repair a humanoid rig in place (non-destructively): fills `rig.synthesized` with inferred joints and `rig.healed` with a list of what was repaired.

**Parameters:**

- `model` *(object)* — EngineModel
- `rig` *(object)* — model.rigs.humanoid
- `[pose]` *(Map)* — node-hierarchy world map

**Returns:** }

### `analyzeSymmetry(model, pose)`

Find the skeleton's plane of bilateral symmetry.

**Returns:** |null}

### `healSkeleton(model, pose)`

Heal a generic skeleton by mirroring limbs that exist on only one side.

**Returns:** }
